title: CHU-B labour dialogue after 25 July assembly
location: Brazzaville, CHU-B and Departmental Labour Directorate
current_month_evidence: ADIAC report says negotiations took place 4–6 August at the Departmental Labour Directorate and 7–8 August at CHU-B, with conclusions signed 8 August.
notes: Administrative dialogue followed the July assembly; no separate August public gathering is evidenced. This is episode follow-up, not a new August observation.
